lines.text: That party was kind of lame.

data.define: Used for things that are dull or not cool.

example.text: That party was kind of lame.

misuse.text: Don't call a friend's idea 'lame' in front of everyone.

native.tip: “lame” = garing. Contoh: “That party was kind of lame.”
